advisorySource.note: The npm registry advisory endpoint answers from the lockfile's resolved name@version set. No node_modules, credential or environment value is read.

note: Blocking severities are declared here, not in code, so a policy change is a reviewable one-line diff. `enforcement: audit` records blocking findings and still fails on unavailable advisory data; flipping it to `block` is the escalation step described in docs/runbook/dependency-advisories.md section 6.
